budget_items.topic: Federal grant for Turkey Hill Middle School solar array
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A federal grant paid for a solar array at Turkey Hill Middle School; the Town will own it after 15 years, and savings are expected to be about $10,000 per year for the first 15 years.
budget_items.quote: a federal grant for $150,000 has paid for a solar array at turkey hill middle school.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lighting work costing $48,000 was funded largely by Unitil ($34,000), leaving $14,000 to the Town, with savings of $5,500 per year.
